output:
I'll start by discovering the tickets MCP tools.

Ticket 223 returned an empty response, and 211 differs between search (billing) and get (platform). I'll re-fetch both.

I wrote `/app/report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json` (status `success`). Both files parse as valid JSON. I only read tickets and changed none.

| Team | Open P1 | Unanswered |
|---|---|---|
| billing | 2 | 231 |
| data | 5 | 214, 219 |
| identity | 4 | 220 |
| mobile | 2 | 228 |
| platform | 5 | 211, 217 |

The counts add up to the 18 open P1 tickets the search returned. I read the comments on every ticket. A ticket counts as unanswered when its only comments, if any, are from its own customer.

Ticket 211 is listed under billing in the search results but under platform in the ticket record, where its title also carries an escalation note. I used the ticket record, so it counts under platform. If the search listing is the right one, billing would be 3 open with unanswered `[211, 231]`. Platform would drop to 4 open with unanswered `[217]`.
